summary: Zhibao Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, reporting the effectiveness of a one-for-fifty reverse share split of its Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.0001, approved at the September 29, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. The condition was met as the closing bid price was $0.0805 on September 29, 2026, below the US$0.12 threshold. The split becomes effective October 9, 2026, with trading adjusted on October 12, 2026, under symbol ZBAO and new CUSIP G989MC114. The par value rises to $0.005 per share, with proportionate adjustments to convertible securities and incentive plan reserves. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation.
